cohort: Pregnant women with immune fetal hydrops at a tertiary care hospital between October 2004 and December 2019.
finding: Favorable perinatal outcome was achieved in hydropic fetuses with intra-uterine blood transfusions, and complete resolution of hydrops before delivery increased the chances of perinatal survival.
gest_age: Hydrops diagnosed below 32 weeks (Group A, average 24.2 weeks) and after 32 weeks (Group B, average 32.5 weeks).
